description: Usage writer: a tenant-aware, flag-guarded rollup job that populates the Postgres xp_usage_daily table so the Storage & Retention usage view reports real bytes_stored / per-source breakdown instead of 0. UsageMeteringService already READS xp_usage_daily.bytes_stored; this job WRITES it. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (no code dependency); runs last.
steps: Add the per-day/per-source usage query. In /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/query/TenantScopedQueryBuilder.java add ScopedSql usageDailyBySource(QueryScope scope): SELECT toString(toDate(minute)) AS d, service AS s, sum(bytes) AS b, sum(rows) AS r FROM xp_log_volume_1m with tenant predicate first, AND minute >= toDateTime(?,'UTC') AND minute < toDateTime(?,'UTC') (bound), GROUP BY d, s. Keep the tenant-first invariant.

Add Usage properties. Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/config/XamPulseProperties.java: nested Usage class with enabled (default true), lookbackDays (default 3, so late-arriving rows for recent days get corrected), cron (default "0 35 * * * *"); add getUsage(). Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/resources/application.properties adding xampulse.usage.enabled / .lookback-days / .cron with ${XAMPULSE_USAGE_*:default} placeholders and a comment that bytes_stored is a rollup byte-sum approximation, not true ClickHouse compressed size.

Create the usage rollup job. /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/query/UsageRollupJob.java as @Component("xpUsageRollupJob") @ConditionalOnProperty(name="xampulse.enabled", havingValue="true"). Inject XpAccountConfigRepository, ClickHouseExecutor, XpUsageDailyRepository, SchedulingEnvironmentConfig, XamPulseProperties. @Scheduled(cron = "${xampulse.usage.cron}") runAll(): return early unless scheduling.isSchedulingEnabled() && props.getUsage().isEnabled(); for each XpAccountConfig whose state is CONNECTED/DEGRADED, in its own try/catch: QueryScope over now-lookbackDays..now for that single tenant, run usageDailyBySource via executor.query(scope.forTenant(id)); for each (day, source) row UPSERT an XpUsageDaily (signal="LOGS", source, bytesIn=b, bytesStored=b (approximation), rowCount=r) keyed on the unique (cloud_account_id, day, signal, source) — look up existing by repository (add a finder findByCloudAccountIdAndDayAndSignalAndSource to XpUsageDailyRepository), update in place or insert. Never throw out of runAll.

Add the repository finder. Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/repository/XpUsageDailyRepository.java adding java.util.Optional<XpUsageDaily> findByCloudAccountIdAndDayAndSignalAndSource(Long cloudAccountId, java.time.LocalDate day, String signal, String source). Confirm XamPulseRepositoryScopingTest still accepts the repository (every finder carries cloudAccountId — this one does).

Add unit tests: UsageRollupJobTest (fake executor returns rows for 2 days x 2 sources for one tenant; assert XpUsageDaily rows are upserted with signal LOGS, correct source/bytes/rows; a second run updates in place rather than duplicating; disabled flag or isSchedulingEnabled()==false writes nothing; an executor error for one account does not stop the next) and a usageDailyBySource tenant-scoping case in TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest. Confirm the existing XamPulseRepositoryScopingTest and UsageMeteringService-related tests still pass.
acceptance_criteria: UsageRollupJobTest proves rows are upserted (insert then update-in-place, no duplicate key) and that the job is a no-op when disabled or scheduling is off.

Running mvn -B -pl xamops-service -am test -Dtest='com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.query.UsageRollupJobTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.query.TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.repository.XamPulseRepositoryScopingTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false passes with 0 failures.

No new Flyway migration is needed (xp_usage_daily already exists with the right unique key); if a column were missing a NEW V20261030_8 file would be added rather than editing a shipped one — but none is expected.
findings: Implemented the usage metering writer slice E. Changes: (1) TenantScopedQueryBuilder.usageDailyBySource(scope) -> SELECT toString(toDate(minute)) AS d, service AS s, sum(bytes) AS b, sum(rows) AS r FROM xp_log_volume_1m with the tenant predicate first and the window bounds bound, GROUP BY d, s. (2) XamPulseProperties.Usage nested class (enabled=true, lookbackDays=3, cron='0 35 * * * *') + getUsage(); matching xampulse.usage.* keys in application.properties with ${XAMPULSE_USAGE_*:default} placeholders and a comment that bytes_stored is a rollup byte-sum approximation, not true ClickHouse compressed size. (3) XpUsageDailyRepository.findByCloudAccountIdAndDayAndSignalAndSource(...) finder (tenant-scoped; XamPulseRepositoryScopingTest still passes). (4) New job at service/query/XpUsageRollupJob.java, @Component("xpUsageRollupJob") @ConditionalOnProperty(xampulse.enabled=true), @Scheduled(cron=${xampulse.usage.cron}); runAll() returns early unless scheduling.isSchedulingEnabled() && usage.enabled, iterates CONNECTED/DEGRADED XpAccountConfig in per-account try/catch (never throws out), builds a now-lookbackDays..now single-tenant QueryScope, runs usageDailyBySource via executor.query(scope.forTenant(id)), and upserts an XpUsageDaily per (day, source) keyed on (cloud_account_id, day, signal=LOGS, source) with bytesIn=b, bytesStored=b (documented approximation), rowCount=r. NAMING NOTE: the task named the class UsageRollupJob, but a class with that simple name already exists at com.xammer.cloud.service.automation.workload.usage.store.UsageRollupJob and XamPulseWiringTest forbids a XamPulse class simple-name clash with another package; the class/file were therefore named XpUsageRollupJob (bean name remains xpUsageRollupJob). No DTO changed, so no contract sample regeneration. No new Flyway migration needed (xp_usage_daily already carries the unique key). Tests added: XpUsageRollupJobTest (6 cases: per-(day,source) upsert with correct bytes/rows and bytesStored==bytesIn; second run updates in place with no duplicate key; disabled flag no-op; scheduling-off no-op; inactive accounts skipped; one failing account does not stop the others) and a usageDailyBySource tenant-scoping case in TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest (also added to its everyStatement() invariant sweep). Verification: mvn compile OK; targeted suite (XpUsageRollupJobTest, TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest, XamPulseRepositoryScopingTest) 22 tests 0 failures; full xampulse.** suite 427 tests 0 failures. AwsPermissionCatalogKubernetesTest was not in scope (pre-existing, unrelated).
